description: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens to a Codex upstream with token_count_estimate off in the new core: it answers that the account cannot count. Today's core has no such setting and always estimates.

exceptions.reason: token_count_estimate is off in the new core, which then answers that the account cannot count (Codex has no token count endpoint); today's core has no such setting and answers with its local estimate.
